newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu to raise Sep wholesale oil product prices.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu to raise Sep wholesale oil product prices.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Monday it would raise wholesale prices for gasoline, gas oil and kerosene by 0.3 yen per litre, effective September 1.
The upward price adjustment is the result of the yen's depreciation against the dollar amid stable crude oil prices for July lifting, an Idemitsu spokesman said.
The price increase will bring the gasoline price to 88.5 yen per litre, including tax, he said.
Gas oil and kerosene will be priced at 34.5 yen a litre.
Another leading oil firm, Nippon Oil Co Ltd, said last Friday it would raise its wholesale oil product prices by 0.3 yen a litre for September shipments.
Japan's major oil companies review their wholesale product prices on a monthly basis, taking into account international crude prices as well as fluctuations in the currency market.
